maddeler.e:
نستتر (form VIII)
# نَسْتَتِرُ (nastatiru) /nas.ta.ti.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
# نَسْتَتِرَ (nastatira) /nas.ta.ti.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
# نَسْتَتِرْ (nastatir) /nas.ta.tir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
